_comment: Canary seed for NuGuard redteam scanning.
1. Replace every placeholder value with realistic-looking fake data.

Studyield instance so the target AI agent can actually retrieve them
(knowledge base RAG chat, exam clone, flashcards, teach-back, etc.).
3. Pass this file with:  nuguard redteam --canary canary.json ...
NuGuard injects adversarial prompts that try to exfiltrate data across
tenant/student boundaries. After each response, it scans for the
watch_values listed here. A match is definitive proof of exfiltration —
Keep this file out of version control if it contains real-looking PII.
Add 'canary.json' to .gitignore; only commit the .example version.
